parties: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited; Care Ratings Limited (Monitoring Agency)
headline: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited: Q1 FY26-27 Monitoring Agency Report
sum: Care Ratings Limited, as appointed Monitoring Agency, filed the Q1 FY26-27 utilisation-of-proceeds report for ACJKEL's public issue, pursuant to SEBI LODR 2015 and ICDR 2018 requirements.
implication: Routine quarterly monitoring of public issue proceeds utilisation is a mandatory disclosure gating item for listed companies post-IPO; this report documents compliance with capital deployment conditions precedent to the public offering.
detail: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited, a listed entity on NSE, appointed Care Ratings Limited as Monitoring Agency to oversee utilisation of funds raised through its public issue. The Q1 FY26-27 monitoring report was filed on 14 Aug 2026 in compliance with regulation 32(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015 and regulation 41(4) of the SEBI Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements (ICDR) Regulations, 2018. The report is a mandatory quarterly submission tracking deployment of capital raised and certifying adherence to the stated objects of the issue.
